profile.summary: Bafna Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures and sells finished pharmaceutical formulations in India. The company offers its products in various dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, and solid orals. It provides various products for cardiovascular and hypertension, potent oncology, anti-infectives, central nervous system, and diabetic related diseases, as well as provision of contract research
